frozenChangeRequires: owner authorization where architectural, privacy-affecting, or scope/science-altering

frozen.decision: science authority is a pure TypeScript package with no DOM, React, Phaser, storage or network dependency
React and Phaser are presentation only, coupled by a typed view model and bounded intents
motion is analytical and 1D; no physics engine or numerical integrator produces an authoritative value
SI units, +x is rightward, x0 = 0 and v0 = 0 by default, inertial lab frame
governing relations are Fnet = sum(F), a = Fnet/m, v(t) = v0 + a*t, x(t) = x0 + v0*t + 0.5*a*t^2
resistive force exists only when explicitly declared, is constant within a segment and opposes the declared motion; drag and friction transitions are out of v1
authoritative values are never rounded; display rounding uses one canonical round-half-away-from-zero rule and never feeds back
numeric answer tolerance is authored and recorded; categorical answers are exact; a sign error always fails
one independent variable changes at a time in every assessed comparison
v1 is bounded to the 1D NGSS MS-PS2-2 slice; projectile, rotational, collision, energy and momentum curriculum is out of scope
difficulty increases through reasoning burden, not numeric size
four canonical mission families are the v1 content set
Thruster Test carries the mandated graph-interpretation requirement
Mystery Cart is diagnosed from controlled evidence, never an answer key
scored comparators are PhET Forces and Motion: Basics, Algodoo and Poly Bridge 3; Kerbal Space Program is reference-only
quality scorecard rows and Meets/Below definitions are frozen, including gate summaries
the complete investigation is completable with semantic controls without precision canvas interaction
automated accessibility checks never constitute accessibility sign-off; manual evidence is required and never fabricated
the learner runtime is local-first with no accounts, trackers, telemetry, LLM calls or remote learner data
no third-party observability SDK ships to measure performance
performance is a measurement methodology plus a pinned ML-02 baseline; thresholds are not invented to pass an issue
every production scenario carries a complete schema-valid provenance manifest; an unreviewed scenario may not ship
every nontrivial asset records origin, tool or author, license and derivation; unknown-origin assets may not ship
released candidates are immutable and identified by source SHA, lockfile digest, version, build hash, prefix and games-site pointer
promotion selects an already-qualified artifact without rebuild; rollback is exercised and never mutates immutable artifacts
technology baseline is TypeScript, React 19, Vite, Phaser 4.2.1, SVG/React graphs, Vitest, Playwright, axe-core, Figma, Web Audio
LevelBest integration is out of scope for GAME-382 and must not be added
ML-11 is a hard gate: no production content expansion or final polish before the vertical slice proves the loop
target grade band is 6-8 and instructional copy targets a grade 6-7 reading level
session shape is one self-contained mission of 6-12 minutes with no hub, currency or unlock grind
